title: No other term shows an info icon or a lock icon
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure all twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due 14 days after the invoice date.
  • Have the shop's own active term B, due on day 10 of the following month.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps: 1. Look at the Name cell of every row other than COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Net 7, Net 15, Net 20, Net 30, Net 45, Net 50, Net 60, Net 90, Net 120, term A and term B show their name only: no info icon and no lock icon (COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold are the only rows with them).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R10: “No other term (standard Net terms and every term the shop created) shows an info icon or a lock icon.”
  • Key Decisions: “The page explains every term inline in a Due column; only COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold carry an info tooltip.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
